summary:
Iteration 7 — tested all iter7 features: dashboard BPJS stats, new configs (COMPANY_ADDRESS, PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_NAME/TITLE, CSV_DELIMITER + validation), CSV_DELIMITER applied to BSI export + YTD template + attendance import template, PDF header company name/address + signature block (verified via pypdf text extraction), new submit/reject/approve workflow with Staff HR (admin_payroll) role, Pajak merged tabs page, Jadwal-Shift merged page with redirects from /tax-forms and /rotations, tester-login-staff button, and delete period for draft/revision/pending.

Backend: 18 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_workflow_v7.py plus updates to backend_test.py (test_z1 now accepts already-approved Maret seed; test_save_draft cleans up its TEST_ period). Full regression 103/103 pass (pytest -n0, ~30s): backend_test.py (18), test_1721a1_and_delete_period.py (8), test_rotations_and_import.py, test_schedules.py, test_shift_recap.py, test_tax_and_bsi.py, test_workflow_v7.py (18). Dashboard confirmed total_bpjs_kes=560964 and total_bpjs_tk=970200 for Maret 2026. CSV delimiter validation enforces , ; | tab (anything else → 400). PDF correctly includes COMPANY_NAME, COMPANY_ADDRESS, PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_NAME, PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_TITLE text.

Frontend verified at preview URL:
- Login page: tester-login-staff button present (hrd + staff + budi/siti/dimas).
- Staff login → /hr-manager, role label 'Staff HR / Admin Payroll'.
- NAV has nav-{dashboard,payroll,karyawan,absensi,jadwal-shift,rekap-shift,pajak,konfigurasi}. Old nav items (jadwal, rotasi, pajak-ytd, 1721-a1) are gone.
- nav-pajak → /hr-manager/tax with tab-ytd and tab-a1.
- nav-jadwal-shift → /hr-manager/schedules with tab-schedules and tab-rotations.
- /hr-manager/tax-forms redirects → /hr-manager/tax?tab=a1 and /hr-manager/rotations redirects → /hr-manager/schedules?tab=rotations.
- Configs page shows config-COMPANY_ADDRESS, config-PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_NAME, config-PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_TITLE, config-CSV_DELIMITER inputs.
- Dashboard shows stat-total-bpjs-kes 'Rp 560.964' and stat-total-bpjs-tk 'Rp 970.200'.
- Full workflow UI (Staff creates period TEST_UIFlow_Jul26 → Proses Payroll → Ajukan ke Manager → status 'MENUNGGU APPROVAL' + pending-banner; workbench overtime/save disabled, no approve-lock button for staff). Manager logs in, sees reject-period-button; approve-all enabled only in pending; reject-dialog gates confirm until reason ≥ 5 chars; after reject status becomes 'DITOLAK · REVISI' with rejection-banner showing the reason text; review-history panel shows 'Diajukan ke Manager' + 'Ditolak' entries with the Alasan text; approve-all disabled in revision.

Cleanup: All TEST_ periods deleted via direct Mongo (API delete rejects approved). CSV_DELIMITER restored to ','; company/signatory configs restored to defaults. Maret 2026 seed untouched (3 approved payslips, THP 13.234.810, BPJS totals intact).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_hr.delete_period references EDITABLE_STATUSES before it is defined in the module (line 253 vs 261). It works because the function body isn't executed at import time, but conceptually fragile — move EDITABLE_STATUSES above its first reference for clarity.
Periods.jsx 'Buka' link lacks a stable data-testid (e.g. open-period-${id}); current E2E tests must rely on tr→text selector. Adding testid would make UI tests more robust.

routes_hr.delete_period allows deleting a 'pending_approval' period silently via staff role — this effectively lets Staff HR cancel their own submission without manager action. Not a bug per spec (spec says delete allowed for draft/revision/pending without approved slips), but worth confirming business intent.

pdf_service.render_payslip renders COMPANY_NAME & COMPANY_ADDRESS raw into HTML paragraph with <b> tags; if admin pastes special chars (<, &) the reportlab paraparser may error. Consider html-escaping cfg values before embedding.
PayslipPDF signature table uses rowHeights with fixed mm → long signatory titles (long jabatan) may overflow silently. Low priority.

Backend test_tax_and_bsi.py and test_1721a1_and_delete_period.py do not always clean up TEST_ periods they create (leftover TEST_BSI_empty, TEST_Desember 2026 were present in DB before this iteration). Not functionally broken but pollutes DB between iterations.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — used hrd.manager@rumatku.id (manager_hrd), staff.hr@rumatku.id (admin_payroll), EMP-001 (employee). All Password123!.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created periods TEST_Workflow Apr 2026, TEST_UIFlow_Jul26, TEST_Delete Draft/Pending/Revision. All deleted (direct Mongo for approved ones). Configs COMPANY_NAME/ADDRESS/PAYSLIP_SIGNATORY_* were temporarily overwritten during PDF test and restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/ (103 total, 7 files). Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -n0`. Approved TEST_ periods cannot be deleted via API (returns 400) — tests that approve must clean up via direct pymongo (MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017, DB_NAME=test_database). Maret 2026 seed is PRE-APPROVED; any test that calls POST /periods/{maret}/approve-all directly now returns 400 — must first check status, submit if needed, then approve. Reject requires reason ≥ 5 chars and status==pending_approval. Staff role 'admin_payroll' can submit but not approve/reject; manager_hrd required for approve-all, approve-one, reject.
rca of the issue: No defects. Prior-iteration test failures observed in initial run (test_z2/z3/z4 + TestA1ListNoYtd) were caused by DB pollution from leftover TEST_Workflow Apr 2026 approved periods accumulating a second Budi payslip in 2026 — doubled i1+i3 from 8.3M to 16.9M and reordered employee payslip list. After adding direct-Mongo cleanup in test_workflow_v7._cleanup_period and purging stale TEST_ periods, all 103 tests pass. Documented as code review item against test_tax_and_bsi.py.
